title: A review of decade-channel's public API
body:
Writing `decade-channel`'s README for 0.2.0 meant using its whole public API from example programs, and several parts were awkward or wrong. Jack plans to review the API design as a whole before anyone polishes its documentation. Each child is one point the README work turned up.

The README in `decade-channel/README.md` and the programs in `decade-channel/examples/` are the current picture of how a client uses the crate. Expect to rewrite them after this review.
